title: Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman Yojana (PM POSHAN Scheme):
summary: Schemes — Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman Yojana (PM POSHAN Scheme):

items:  Objective: Provide hot cooked meals in government and government-aided schools
 Target: 11.8 crore children in 11 lakh schools
 Hot Cooked Meals replacing the mid-day meal scheme
 Increased Food Allocation: 100g for primary (1-5) and 150g for upper primary (6-8) children
 Nutrition Gardens in schools for experiential learning
 Tithi Bhojan: Community participation in meal sponsorship
 Hygiene & Safety Standards in food preparation
This scheme improves children's nutrition, promotes community involvement, and supports
